descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Step inside a fully immersive analytical chemistry laboratory and learn to operate real ion chromatography instrumentation across the 4 modules — hands-on, without ever setting foot in a lab.

Designed for third-level undergraduate chemistry students, this VR experience guides learners through the complete analytical workflow: exploring instrumentation and its components, initialising the system and software, performing sample injection, and generating and interpreting chromatographic data.

Whether you're a student preparing for lab work, an educator looking for an engaging teaching tool, or simply curious about analytical science, Immersive ChemLab offers an accessible and realistic training environment. Its intuitive design also makes it a compelling introduction to analytical chemistry for anyone who is interested.

Immersive ChemLab is an active development project. We welcome your feedback, suggestions — and compliments! Get in touch at aoife.morrin@dcu.ie

Also available: Immersive ChemLab – Atomic Absorption Spectrometry.
